name: iterate
title: Iterate on an existing app
description: Add a feature or fix a bug on an app that already exists in app_build, without rebuilding from scratch. Short: scope the change, build it, review.

phases.title: Scope the change
phases.purpose: The app ALREADY exists and compiles in app_build. Decide exactly what to change to satisfy the latest requested change (see the '## Change requested' section of the prompt): which files to touch and what to add. Keep it minimal and preserve existing behavior. Do NOT rebuild from scratch.

phases.title: Build the change
phases.purpose: Make the requested change to the EXISTING app in app_build. Extend the current code; do not rebuild from scratch and do not delete working features. Ship a compiling app.

phases.title: Review
phases.purpose: Go/no-go on the change: what changed, what still works, and the top risks. One round.
